stories.h: Kano Governor Abba Yusuf says his wife was taken from his home before she went to court
stories.p: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly given more details about the breakdown of his marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso. In a radio interview he said her belongings were moved out of his house without his knowledge, and that he was shocked when she filed for divorce in Abuja.
body: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly opened up further about the collapse of his marriage to Zainab Musa Kwankwaso, a relative of NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.
## What the governor said

Speaking in a Hausa-language interview on Sunday, 22 November 2026, Yusuf is said to have described family matters as extremely difficult. He reportedly said he and Zainab married about 20 years ago and have children together.

According to the reports, the governor said her belongings were moved out of his house and she was taken away from his home without his knowledge, but that he stayed patient and said nothing in public. He said he had even assured their children that their mother would come back, and was shocked to learn that she had gone to court, in Abuja rather than in Kano.
Yusuf reportedly declined to give details of how she left, but said he had witnesses. Asked why he was speaking publicly, he said he was not the one who had made the matter political.
## Background

Earlier this week, Zainab Kwankwaso reportedly filed for divorce at an Upper Area Court in Abuja. The governor later told pensioners at Government House in Kano that he had accepted the dissolution of the marriage and still planned to marry again.
The split has drawn wide attention because Kwankwaso was long the governor's political mentor before the two fell out.
## The other side
No response from Zainab Kwankwaso or Rabiu Kwankwaso was included in the reports.
more: Yusuf says he was shocked she went to court in Abuja.
He says he has witnesses to how she left.
No response from the Kwankwaso family was reported.

stories.h: Argentina World Cup winner Leandro Paredes collapses during live TV interview
stories.p: Boca Juniors midfielder Leandro Paredes reportedly collapsed while giving a live interview minutes after his club won the Copa Sudamericana. The final was played in intense heat and humidity in Colombia.
body: Argentine midfielder Leandro Paredes, who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup with Argentina, reportedly collapsed on live television on Saturday, 21 November 2026, shortly after Boca Juniors won the Copa Sudamericana.
## What happened
The 32-year-old was giving a post-match interview when he lost consciousness and fell. The journalist beside him reportedly moved quickly to stop his fall before medical staff rushed to help him.
## The heat

The final, at the Estadio Metropolitano in Barranquilla, Colombia, was played in punishing conditions, with temperatures of around 32°C and humidity of about 80 per cent forecast for the day. Paredes is said to have shown signs of distress late in the first half, and his coach later confirmed it. He was substituted in the 57th minute.
## The match

Boca were already 2-0 up by then, and goals from Santiago Ascacibar and Miguel Merentiel gave them victory over Brazilian side Atletico Mineiro. The win ended Boca's 18-year wait for international silverware.
more: Paredes collapsed minutes after the final whistle.
The final was played in 32°C heat in Colombia.
Boca ended an 18-year wait for an international trophy.

stories.h: SERAP sues INEC and data commission over suspected AI-generated photos in voter register
stories.p: SERAP has filed a Federal High Court lawsuit asking for an independent investigation into suspected AI-generated photographs and other questionable records in INEC's preliminary voter register, and into whether voters' personal data was unlawfully accessed or altered.
body: The Socio-Economic Rights and Accountability Project (SERAP) has filed a lawsuit at the Federal High Court seeking an independent investigation into suspected artificial intelligence-generated photographs and other questionable records in INEC's preliminary Register of Voters.
## The lawsuit
The suit, numbered FHC/ABJ/CS/2863/2026, names the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) as defendants.
SERAP is asking the court to compel the data protection commission to examine the relevant records and electronic data held by INEC.
It also wants investigators to establish whether voters' personal information was unlawfully accessed or altered, and whether the Nigeria Data Protection Act was breached.
## What INEC has said

INEC has already acknowledged that suspected AI-generated photographs appeared in the preliminary register. The commission said its Automated Biometric Identification System flagged 268 records involving suspected AI images or other irregularities.
INEC insists the published register is not final, and says verification and data-cleaning will be completed before the register is certified on 15 December.
## What the court has not decided
No court has found INEC responsible for manipulating the register, and the case has not yet been given a public hearing date.
## Why it matters

The voter register is the foundation of any credible election. With the 2027 general elections approaching, questions about its accuracy, and about how voters' personal data is protected, go to the heart of public trust in the process.
## Over to you
Do you trust INEC to clean up the voter register before certification, or is an independent investigation needed?
more: SERAP's suit is FHC/ABJ/CS/2863/2026.
INEC says 268 records were flagged for suspected AI images or irregularities.
INEC plans to certify the register on 15 December.

stories.h: Petrol prices fall by up to ₦85 a litre as Dangote suspends diesel price cut
stories.p: Petrol pump prices have reportedly fallen by between ₦25 and ₦85 per litre in a week as refiners and importers compete. Dangote Refinery has, however, withdrawn a planned ₦150 cut in diesel prices pending a review.
body: Motorists are seeing some relief at filling stations, with petrol prices reportedly falling by between ₦25 and ₦85 per litre over the past seven days.
## Petrol prices

The reductions follow fresh price cuts by Dangote Refinery, importers and major marketers, amid growing competition between locally refined and imported petrol. Dangote has cut its petrol price several times this month, most recently to ₦1,070 per litre on 19 November, its lowest quoted rate since July.
## Diesel U-turn

However, Dangote Refinery has withdrawn an earlier announcement that it would reduce the gantry price of diesel from ₦1,720 to ₦1,570 per litre. In a new message to customers, the refinery said the proposed ₦150 cut, which was meant to take effect on Saturday, 21 November, was still under internal review.
Marketers and businesses that rely on diesel are now waiting for clarity on the new rate.
## Depot prices

Depot prices of petrol and diesel fell between 16 and 20 November in Lagos, Warri, Port Harcourt and Calabar. Lagos saw the biggest cuts, with some depots reducing petrol by as much as ₦120 per litre.
more: Petrol prices have fallen by up to ₦85 a litre.
Dangote's ₦150 diesel cut is under review.
Competition with imported petrol is driving prices down.

stories.h: Troops foil suspected kidnap attempt at Kaduna school
stories.p: Soldiers reportedly foiled a suspected kidnapping attempt at a college in Zangon Kataf, Kaduna State. A headcount showed no student was missing.
body: Troops have reportedly foiled a suspected kidnapping attempt at Tafawa Balewa Memorial Commercial College in Samaru, Zangon Kataf Local Government Area of Kaduna State.
## What happened

The incident happened at about 11:56pm on 18 November 2026, after reports of suspicious movements by unidentified people around the school. Soldiers responded quickly and moved to the school, forcing the suspects to abandon their plan and flee.
## All students safe

The troops searched the school and surrounding areas but did not make contact with the fleeing suspects. A headcount carried out with the school authorities showed that no student or other occupant was missing.
## Security stepped up
The troops have continued patrols in the area to prevent further attacks.
more: The attempt happened late on 18 November.
No student was missing.
Troops are patrolling the area.

stories.h: Aisha Buhari seen in Tinubu-branded outfit, days after claim she backed Atiku
stories.p: A video of former First Lady Aisha Buhari wearing attire printed with President Tinubu's campaign logo has sparked debate. It came days after ADC chieftain Solomon Dalung claimed she had told Atiku that Buhari's supporters would back him.
body: A video of former First Lady Aisha Buhari, widow of the late President Muhammadu Buhari, wearing clothing printed with President Bola Tinubu's campaign logo has stirred political debate ahead of the 2027 elections.
## The video
The clip was posted on Saturday, 21 November 2026, by former presidential aide Bashir Ahmad, with a caption describing it as a message from Daura, Buhari's hometown.
## Why it matters

The video came days after Solomon Dalung, a chieftain of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), claimed in a television interview that Aisha Buhari had visited ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar and told him that the late President's large voter base would be backing him in 2027.
Many social media users took the new video as a response to that claim, suggesting the former First Lady is supporting Tinubu.
## No statement
Aisha Buhari herself had not made a public statement on her political preference at the time of the reports.
more: The video was shared by former aide Bashir Ahmad.
Dalung had claimed she backed Atiku.
She has not made a public statement.
stories.alt: Atiku Abubakar in a blue cap and agbada speaking into a microphone

stories.h: KWAM 1 backs Tinubu's fuel subsidy removal at APC campaign event
stories.p: Fuji star Wasiu Ayinde, KWAM 1, has defended President Tinubu's removal of the petrol subsidy, saying it mainly benefited a small group rather than ordinary Nigerians.
body: Veteran Fuji musician Wasiu Ayinde, popularly known as KWAM 1, has thrown his support behind President Bola Tinubu's removal of the petrol subsidy.
## What he said

Speaking at an APC campaign event in Oyo State on Saturday, 21 November 2026, KWAM 1 argued that the policy was necessary to secure Nigeria's future. He questioned who had really benefited from the subsidy, saying a small group of people had gained from it while ordinary Nigerians saw little benefit.
## Background
The petrol subsidy was removed when Tinubu took office in 2023, leading to a sharp rise in fuel prices.
## The campaign
His comments came during the APC's campaign tour of the South-West, which included a presidential rally in Ibadan.
more: KWAM 1 says the subsidy benefited a few people.
He spoke at an APC event in Oyo State.
The subsidy was removed in 2023.

stories.h: Moniepoint opens North Central regional headquarters in Abuja
stories.p: Moniepoint Microfinance Bank has opened a regional headquarters in Abuja where customers can get in-person help, in line with CBN rules requiring physical locations for national microfinance banks.
body: Digital lender Moniepoint Microfinance Bank has opened its North Central regional headquarters in Abuja, giving customers a place to get face-to-face support.
## Why now
The move is in line with a Central Bank of Nigeria requirement for nationally licensed microfinance banks to keep physical locations alongside their digital services.
## Wider presence

Moniepoint already runs offices and service centres in several states, including Borno, Bauchi, Kaduna, Kano and Sokoto, and its point-of-sale network serves businesses in all 774 local government areas.
more: The new office is in Abuja.
CBN rules require physical locations.
Its POS network covers all 774 LGAs.

stories.h: Farooq Oreagba, 'King of Steeze', reveals cancer relapse
stories.p: Media personality Farooq Oreagba, known as the King of Steeze, says his multiple myeloma has returned. He first received a cancer diagnosis in 2014.
body: Nigerian media personality Farooq Oreagba, popularly known as Mr Steeze or the King of Steeze, has revealed that his cancer has returned.
## The relapse

In a video circulating online, Oreagba said routine checks earlier in 2026 showed worrying changes in some of his results. A later test showed a rise in a key marker for the disease, and a bone marrow biopsy confirmed in August that his multiple myeloma had returned.
## His journey
Oreagba was first diagnosed with cancer in February 2014.
He also shared when he hopes to be free of the disease.
more: His multiple myeloma has returned.
He was first diagnosed in 2014.
A biopsy confirmed the relapse in August.

stories.h: Jim Iyke finally shows off his wife after almost five years together
stories.p: Nollywood actor Jim Iyke has shared photos and videos of his wife for the first time, revealing how they met on a flight to Houston almost five years ago.
body: Nollywood actor Jim Iyke has introduced his wife to the public for the first time, sharing loved-up photos and videos of the couple on Instagram.
## How they met

In the post, the actor said they met almost five years ago in an airport lounge before a flight to Houston. He recalled asking if the seat next to her was free, and said she firmly told him it was taken, but he sat down anyway. They ignored each other for an hour, then burst out laughing when they realised they were on the same flight.
## His tribute

Jim Iyke described their relationship as something sacred rather than hidden, and said they have built a family together and travelled to eight countries. He called her his best friend, his prayer warrior and his wife, and said they have never stopped laughing together.
more: They met on a flight to Houston.
They have been together almost five years.
He calls her his best friend and prayer warrior.

stories.h: Peter Obi says insecurity stops him walking freely in Nigeria, unlike in the UK
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi says security warnings prevent him from taking simple walks in Nigeria, recalling how he walked and took trains freely while living in London.
body: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has spoken about worsening insecurity in Nigeria, saying safety warnings now stop him from taking simple walks or jogging in his own neighbourhood.
## What he said

Addressing the Global Peter Obi Supporters Summit in Abuja on Saturday, 21 November 2026, the former Anambra governor recalled living in the UK, on the same street as the Mayor of London. He said they would walk the streets and take the train without security escorts.
He contrasted that with Nigeria today, recalling that he used to walk freely to church in Lagos in the 1980s and 1990s, but said security concerns now prevent him from doing so.
## The campaign
Insecurity is one of the major issues in the 2027 campaign, ahead of the 16 January election.
more: Obi says he cannot walk freely in Nigeria.
He recalled walking and taking trains in London.
He spoke at a supporters' summit in Abuja.
stories.alt: Peter Obi in glasses and a black top in front of the Nigerian flag

stories.h: Tom Brady buys minority stake in Chelsea
stories.p: NFL legend Tom Brady has reportedly bought a minority stake in Chelsea Football Club. The size of the stake and price were not disclosed.
body: American football great Tom Brady has reportedly bought a minority stake in Premier League club Chelsea.
## The deal
The size of the seven-time Super Bowl winner's stake and the amount he paid have not been disclosed. Chelsea is valued at about $4.2 billion by one leading business publication.
## Leaving Birmingham

The move comes weeks after Brady sold his 3.3% stake in Birmingham City, who play in England's second tier. The reports cited English Football League rules on holding stakes in more than one club as the reason.
## Growing sports portfolio

Since retiring from the NFL, Brady has built up a range of sports investments. He holds a 5% stake in the Las Vegas Raiders and part-owns the Las Vegas Aces basketball team, an E1 boat-racing team and a pickleball team.
## Chelsea's season
The news came on the same day Chelsea suffered a heavy 4-1 home defeat to Leeds United.
more: Brady bought a minority stake in Chelsea.
He recently sold his Birmingham City stake.
Terms were not disclosed.

stories.h: Princess of Wales opens up on how cancer changed her in new documentary
stories.p: Catherine, Princess of Wales, reflects on the physical and emotional toll of her cancer diagnosis in Heal, an upcoming BBC documentary about her recovery.
body: Catherine, Princess of Wales, has opened up about the physical and emotional effects of her cancer diagnosis in an upcoming BBC documentary titled Heal.
## The documentary

The 30-minute film follows her recovery and return to public life. In a preview released ahead of the broadcast, the princess speaks with other people facing serious health challenges and reflects on life after treatment.
## What she said

She said cancer changes a person physically, but also shifts something much deeper, describing recovery as a process of reconnecting with things she once knew and finding hope and joy alongside uncertainty.
## Background
The film is set against the backdrop of her National Three Peaks Challenge in June 2026, when she climbed the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales within 24 hours.
more: The BBC documentary is called Heal.
She says cancer changes you deeply.
It features her Three Peaks Challenge.

stories.h: Former Head of State Abdulsalami Abubakar loses niece
stories.p: Former Head of State General Abdulsalami Abubakar is mourning the death of his niece, Fatimah Hassana Toto. Information Minister Mohammed Idris visited him in Minna to offer condolences.
body: Former Head of State General Abdulsalami Abubakar is mourning the death of his niece, Fatimah Hassana Toto.
## Condolence visit

Minister of Information and National Orientation Mohammed Idris travelled to Minna, Niger State, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, to pay his respects. He visited the former military leader at his Hilltop residence and later joined family members and sympathisers at the family home in Angwar Daji, where prayers were offered for the deceased.
## Who he is
Abdulsalami Abubakar led Nigeria between 1998 and 1999 and oversaw the return to civilian rule.
more: His niece was Fatimah Hassana Toto.
The Information Minister visited him in Minna.
Prayers were held at the family home.

stories.h: Leeds stun Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge
stories.p: Leeds United beat Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League. Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso admitted the loss was painful and that his side's confidence has taken a hit.
body: Leeds United inflicted a heavy 4-1 defeat on Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on matchday 11 of the Premier League on Saturday, 21 November 2026.
## The match
Emmanuel Emegha gave Chelsea an early lead on his first start for the club since joining in the summer. Leeds hit back quickly through Noah Okafor, and the sides went into half-time level at 1-1.
After the break, Leeds were awarded a penalty when Morgan Rogers was judged to have handled the ball in the area, a decision that sparked debate, and went on to complete a convincing win.
## Alonso's reaction
Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso said the result was painful and reflected a team struggling to keep up its earlier form. He admitted his players' confidence had taken a hit at a difficult time.
## Palmer and Pedro row

After the match, a video appeared to show Cole Palmer and the injured Joao Pedro exchanging words on the touchline before Palmer walked straight down the tunnel. Alonso described it as a fragile moment for the club and urged players and fans to stay united. The defeat was Chelsea's third in four league games and dropped them to eighth.
more: Leeds won 4-1 at Stamford Bridge.
Emegha scored Chelsea's only goal.
Alonso admitted his side's confidence is low.

stories.h: Tinubu arrives in Lagos for family prayer session after Ibadan rally
stories.p: President Tinubu arrived in Lagos on Saturday after his campaign rally in Ibadan, ahead of a special prayer session his family has organised for him on Sunday. He was received by Governors Sanwo-Olu and Abiodun.
body: President Bola Tinubu arrived in Lagos on Saturday, 21 November 2026, after addressing an APC presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State.
## The arrival

His aircraft landed at the Presidential Wing of the Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja at about 3pm. He was received by Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, Ogun Governor Dapo Abiodun, his Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila and former Ogun governor Segun Osoba, along with party leaders and supporters.
## Family prayer
The visit is centred on a special prayer session organised in his honour by members of his family, scheduled for Sunday, 22 November. The President is expected to return to Abuja afterwards.
## The campaign

The trip comes as the APC steps up its campaign across the South-West. At the Ibadan rally, Tinubu endorsed the party's governorship candidates in Oyo, Ogun and Lagos and promised improved electricity supply.
more: Tinubu landed in Lagos at about 3pm.
Sanwo-Olu and Abiodun received him.
A family prayer session holds on Sunday.
stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu in a green cap and glasses at a meeting

stories.h: Tinubu endorses APC governorship candidates in Oyo, Ogun and Lagos at Ibadan rally, promises better power
stories.p: At an APC rally at Mapo Hall in Ibadan, President Tinubu raised the hands of the party's governorship candidates for Oyo, Ogun and Lagos. He also guaranteed improved electricity and promised a factory in Ibadan.
body: President Bola Tinubu has publicly endorsed the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidates in Oyo, Ogun and Lagos States at a campaign rally at Mapo Hall in Ibadan on Saturday, 21 November 2026.
## The endorsements

Telling the crowd he would show them who to vote for as governor, Tinubu raised the hands of Senator Sharafadeen Alli, the APC candidate in Oyo; Senator Solomon Adeola, known as Yayi, the party's candidate in Ogun; and Lagos Deputy Governor Obafemi Hamzat, the APC flagbearer in Lagos. He also raised the hand of Remi Oseni, the party's senatorial candidate for Oyo South.
## Promise on power

During the visit, the President also assured Nigerians of better electricity supply, saying the Minister of Power and his team were working hard. He added that the government would build a factory in Ibadan.
## Context
The rally is part of the APC's campaign ahead of the 16 January 2027 elections.
## The other side
Reactions from the opposition parties to the rally were not included in the reports.
## 'Heavy heart'

Tinubu later said he deliberately kept the Ibadan rally low-key out of respect for families grieving after the Bayelsa boat accident, and that he came to the city with a heavy heart. He thanked the Olubadan, the Soun and other traditional rulers for their welcome.
more: Tinubu endorsed candidates in Oyo, Ogun and Lagos.
He guaranteed improved electricity.
He promised a factory in Ibadan.

stories.h: Jimmy Odukoya sues sister and Fountain of Life trustees over his removal
stories.p: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya has filed a lawsuit at the Federal High Court in Lagos against his sister, Tolu Odukoya, and members of the Fountain of Life Church board over his removal as senior pastor.
body: Pastor Jimmy Odukoya has gone to court over his removal as senior pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, filing a suit against his sister and several members of the church's board of trustees.
## The suit

The suit was filed at the Federal High Court in Lagos on Friday, 20 November 2026. Eight people are named as respondents, including his sister Tolu Odukoya, interim leader Pastor Rotimi Okpaise and other trustees.
The filing marks a significant escalation in the leadership dispute at the Ilupeju church founded by his late father, Taiwo Odukoya.
## Background

Earlier this week, the trustees announced that Jimmy had been removed because his appointment did not reflect his father's succession wishes, and released a 2021 video in which the late founder reportedly named Pastor Kunle Areogun as his successor. Jimmy has insisted his removal is invalid. A Lagos State High Court had already granted the trustees an order barring him from acting as senior pastor while their own suit is heard.
## What happens next
The court is expected to fix a date to hear the case. The trustees had not responded publicly to the new suit in the reports.
## Rousing welcome

At Sunday service on 22 November, Jimmy Odukoya received loud cheers and applause from the congregation as he arrived, despite the court order barring him from presenting himself as senior pastor. There was an unusually heavy security presence around the church.
## 'I have not been served'

Speaking to the congregation on Sunday, Jimmy said he had heard about the injunction against him but had not seen it or been formally served, so legally it had not reached him. He pledged to carry on with his ministry. The Lagos State High Court order was granted on 18 November, and the matter was adjourned to 1 December.
## Bishop Mike Okonkwo visits

Bishop Mike Okonkwo, who helped found the church, also attended a service and told worshippers the church had been battered on social media in recent weeks. He said he could not be separated from the Fountain of Life Church.
more: The suit names eight respondents, including his sister.
It was filed at the Federal High Court in Lagos.
A separate court order bars him from acting as senior pastor.

stories.h: Issakaba Returns sets opening weekend record for a Nollywood action film
stories.p: Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen's Issakaba Returns has reportedly grossed ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend, the highest-ever debut for an action thriller at the Nigerian box office.
body: Nollywood action thriller Issakaba Returns has reportedly set a new box office record, earning ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend.
## The record
The figure makes it the highest-grossing debut ever for an action thriller at the Nigerian box office. The film premiered at a cinema in Victoria Island, Lagos, before its general cinema release.
## The filmmaker
Director Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen, popularly known as D'Guvnor, thanked everyone who bought tickets and supported the film, describing the achievement as more than just numbers.
more: It grossed ₦47.8 million in its opening weekend.
It is a record for a Nigerian action thriller.
It was directed by Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen.

stories.h: NELFUND reviewing ₦20,000 monthly upkeep for students
stories.p: The Nigerian Education Loan Fund says it is reviewing the ₦20,000 monthly upkeep allowance it pays to student beneficiaries, citing economic pressures. MD Akin Sawyer said any increase must be carefully considered.
body: The Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) is considering an increase to the ₦20,000 monthly upkeep allowance it pays to student beneficiaries.
## What was said
NELFUND's Managing Director, Akin Sawyer, said in a television interview on Friday, 20 November 2026, that the allowance was being reviewed in light of the economic pressures facing students.
He said the matter is under constant review, but stressed that any increase would need careful consideration.
## Background
NELFUND, set up under President Bola Tinubu's administration, gives loans to students in tertiary institutions and pays a monthly upkeep allowance to beneficiaries.
more: The allowance is currently ₦20,000 a month.
NELFUND says it is under review.
Any increase must be carefully considered.

stories.h: Suspected insurgents bomb power lines linking Kainji Dam to Jebba
stories.p: Suspected Boko Haram insurgents reportedly blew up two electricity transmission towers connecting the Kainji Dam power plant to Jebba in Niger State. No lives were lost, but the attack raised fears over the safety of power infrastructure.
body: Suspected Boko Haram insurgents have reportedly bombed two electricity transmission towers connecting the Kainji Dam power station to Jebba in Niger State.
## What happened

The explosions reportedly happened at about 2pm on 17 November 2026, between Kanti community in Mashegu Local Government Area and Kanya community in Mokwa Local Government Area. The attackers are said to have targeted the transmission infrastructure, raising concerns that the Kainji Dam power plant itself could be at risk.
No lives were lost, according to the reports, but the blasts caused panic in nearby communities. Security monitoring has continued in the area.
## Why it matters
Kainji and Jebba are hydropower stations that feed the national grid.
## Background

The incident follows a series of attacks on and vandalism of electricity infrastructure across the country. This month, the House of Representatives resolved to investigate the destruction of 10 transmission towers within five months.
more: The blasts happened on 17 November.
No lives were lost.
The House is probing attacks on transmission towers.

stories.h: Nigeria begins building $70m passport factory, local production from May 2027
stories.p: The federal government has started building a $70 million passport production plant in Abuja. Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo says it will start producing passport booklets locally from May 2027.
body: Nigeria has started building a $70 million passport production plant in Abuja, as the federal government moves to end its reliance on foreign suppliers for passport booklets.
## The announcement

Minister of Interior Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo announced the project at a groundbreaking ceremony at the headquarters of the Nigeria Immigration Service. He described it as a major step towards a self-sufficient passport system and said local production should begin by May 2027.
## The plant
The facility is being built in partnership with IRIS Smart Technologies and will initially produce six million electronic passport booklets a year, with capacity that could later rise to 10 million.
## Why it matters
The plant is meant to end Nigeria's reliance on foreign suppliers for passport booklets.
more: The plant will cost $70 million.
Production should start by May 2027.
It will make six million passports a year at first.

stories.h: Sowore makes surprise Onitsha market visit, says 'no rented crowds'
stories.p: AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore says he received a spontaneous welcome at Onitsha's Ogbo Ogwu market, a day after Peter Obi campaigned in the city. He also criticised the partition on the Niger Bridge.
body: African Action Congress (AAC) presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore has made a surprise visit to the Ogbo Ogwu medicine market in Onitsha, Anambra State, where he says traders gave him a warm welcome.
## The visit
Sowore shared details of the visit on X on Saturday, 21 November 2026. He said he walked across the First Niger Bridge and arrived at the market without any prior announcement.
He described the reception as spontaneous and genuine, insisting that no crowds had been hired or organised for his arrival, and promised to return.
## Bridge complaint
During the visit, Sowore criticised Works Minister David Umahi over a partition installed on the Niger Bridge, claiming it was disrupting traffic and causing hardship for commuters.
## Context
His visit came a day after NDC candidate Peter Obi held a campaign event in Onitsha.
more: Sowore visited Ogbo Ogwu market unannounced.
He says the crowd was not hired.
He criticised the Niger Bridge partition.

stories.h: Femi Branch opens up on two years out of work after on-set accident
stories.p: Actor Femi Branch says a stunt that went wrong on a film set in Ikorodu left him unable to work for two years, forcing him to sell his late mother's car. He said some colleagues abandoned him.
body: Nollywood actor Femi Branch has opened up about a difficult period in his life after a serious accident on a film set left him unable to work for two years.
## The accident

In an interview that surfaced online on Friday, 20 November 2026, Branch said he was injured while shooting a stunt in Ikorodu, Lagos. He said he had to jump from a storey building while dressed as a security guard, and the impact when he landed was so severe it sounded like an explosion.
## Hard times

He said the injury kept him out of work for two years, leaving him isolated and in financial difficulty. He revealed that he had to sell his mother's car during that period, and said some colleagues deserted him while he was recovering.
more: The accident happened during a stunt in Ikorodu.
He was out of work for two years.
He sold his mother's car to get by.

stories.h: Former senator Aishatu Binani announces death of her father
stories.p: Former Adamawa governorship candidate and ex-senator Aishatu Dahiru Ahmed, known as Binani, has announced the death of her father after a brief illness. His funeral prayer was fixed for Saturday at the Central Mosque.
body: Former senator and Adamawa State governorship candidate Aishatu Dahiru Ahmed, popularly known as Binani, has announced the death of her father.
## The announcement

stories.p: Hausa praise singer Dauda Kahutu Rarara, a well-known supporter of President Tinubu, was attacked by an angry crowd at the Abuja National Mosque during Friday prayers. Security operatives struggled to hold the crowd back.

Rarara, a prominent supporter of President Bola Tinubu, was entering the mosque with plain-clothed and uniformed security personnel when a group of people rushed at him. Security operatives tried to hold the crowd back but could not fully contain them. At one point, the singer removed his cap, which carried Tinubu's insignia.
A video of the incident has spread widely online.

stories.h: Bayelsa boat disaster: 24 bodies recovered, more than 40 still missing
stories.p: NEMA says 24 bodies have been recovered and more than 40 people are still missing after an overcrowded boat carrying mourners capsized in Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa State. Governor Douye Diri has ordered an investigation.
body: A boat said to be carrying more than 300 passengers has capsized in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State, with many people feared dead or missing.
## What happened
The boat was travelling from Ayama community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony when it capsized at about noon on Friday, 20 November 2026, shortly after passing Oweikorogha community.
The exact number of passengers on board and the number of casualties had not been established at the time of the reports, but residents fear several people may have lost their lives.
## Rescue efforts

The Bayelsa State Police Command spokesperson, DSP Musa Muhammad, confirmed the incident and said the Commissioner of Police had deployed the Marine Police Unit and the local divisional police officer for rescue operations. He said further details on casualties and missing persons would be released.
A former state chairman of the Maritime Workers Union also confirmed the incident.
## Death toll rises

Later reports put the number feared dead at at least 30, with around 300 others unaccounted for. Witnesses described the boat as heavily overloaded, and a community source said some people had raised concerns as passengers boarded.
## What happens next
Rescue and recovery efforts are continuing, and official casualty figures are expected once they are confirmed.
## Death toll rises to 24

The National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) said on Sunday, 22 November, that 24 bodies had been recovered from the river and more than 40 people were still missing. Police had earlier put the death toll at four and said the boat suffered a mechanical failure.

Governor Douye Diri visited the scene on Saturday and ordered an investigation, saying the accident should not have happened if every level of government had done its job. President Tinubu said he kept his Ibadan rally low-key out of respect for the grieving families.

stories.h: Court rejects Atiku's bid to add new evidence to suit against Tinubu's eligibility
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has dismissed an application by Atiku Abubakar to introduce fresh evidence into his suit challenging President Tinubu's eligibility for 2027. The judge said the constitutional 14-day window had passed.
body: A Federal High Court in Abuja has thrown out an application by ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar to bring new evidence into his suit challenging President Bola Tinubu's eligibility to contest the 2027 election.
## The ruling

Justice Inyang Ekwo held that Section 285(9) of the Constitution allows only 14 days for evidence to be filed in a pre-election case. He found that Atiku's request to amend his originating summons would effectively bring in fresh evidence after that period had expired, which would breach the Constitution.
## The NYSC certificate

The suit challenges Tinubu's eligibility over the authenticity of his National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) discharge certificate. The judge upheld objections from President Tinubu, the APC and INEC, saying the proposed amendments went beyond clerical corrections and tried to bring in new facts, fresh claims of fraud and extra exhibits after the defendants had already responded.
## What it means
The ruling is a setback for Atiku's legal challenge, although the main suit itself was not decided in the reports. Atiku's camp had not responded publicly to the ruling in the reports.
## Background

Atiku is also involved in a separate legal battle over his ADC candidacy, after a court on 5 November voided the process that produced him as the party's candidate. INEC has said he will remain on its list until that dispute is settled.

body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) and food critic Opeyemi Famakin have reportedly come to the defence of influencer Enioluwa Adeoluwa, after his comments about young Nigerians sparked a fierce online debate.

Streamer Peller has also appealed to Nigerians to forgive Enioluwa. He said the influencer was wrong, but argued that people make mistakes and should be given the chance to learn rather than be condemned indefinitely.

stories.p: US President Donald Trump has granted a posthumous pardon to baseball great Pete Rose, who pleaded guilty to tax offences in 1990 and was banned from the sport for betting on games.

body: Anambra State Governor Charles Soludo and ADC chieftain Dele Momodu have clashed over the 2027 presidential race in Anambra, a day after Soludo's party, APGA, adopted President Bola Tinubu as its candidate.

stories.h: US corrections officer accused of inviting another man home, then calling him an intruder and firing gun when boyfriend returned
stories.p: Lasacia Gore, a 34-year-old corrections officer in Michigan, has been charged with six felonies. Prosecutors say she invited another man to her home, then reported him as an intruder and fired a gun when her boyfriend came back unexpectedly. She has pleaded not guilty.
body: A 34-year-old woman in Michigan, United States, has been charged with six felonies after police say she invited another man to her home while her boyfriend was away, then reported him as an intruder when her partner returned unexpectedly.
## The 7am phone call

According to prosecutors, Lasacia Gore, a corrections officer with Wayne County, called police at around 7am on Monday, claiming an unknown man had broken into her home in Eastpointe and was fighting with her boyfriend.
But investigators say they found that she had invited the man over herself, and had even left the door unlocked for him.
## What police say happened
According to police, things turned violent when her boyfriend came home unexpectedly, found the visitor in the house and confronted him, leading to a fight.
Eastpointe Police Chief Corey Haines said Gore fired a gun while both men were wrestling on the kitchen floor. The bullet missed them and struck the wall above them.
## "You told me to leave the door open"

Macomb County Prosecutor Pete Lucido said the visitor's account contradicted hers. "She's making a call saying she doesn't know him and this and that, and he says, 'What are you talking about? You're the one who told me to leave the door open and I'm coming in!'" he said.
"It's crazy. This could have been very tragic and somebody could've died," Lucido added.
Chief Haines also expressed concern that a corrections officer was allegedly involved in making a false police report and firing a weapon.
## The charges
Gore faces six felony charges, including assault with a dangerous weapon, discharging a firearm at a building, filing a false felony report, lying to investigators and two firearm-related counts.

She pleaded not guilty at her arraignment on Wednesday. Her bond was set at $30,000, with a 10 per cent option. If released, she must stay at home under GPS monitoring, surrender her weapons and avoid contact with the complainant.
She is due back in court on 2 December for a probable cause conference. The charges are allegations and have not been proven in court.
## Over to you
How could a secret visit have gone so wrong, and what should happen to an officer accused of making a false report?

stories.h: UN top court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.p: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority during the 2017 military crackdown. It is the first time the court has found a state responsible for genocide.
body: The International Court of Justice (ICJ), the United Nations' highest court, has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority during a military crackdown in 2017.
## The ruling

In a landmark judgment on Thursday, 19 November 2026, the court found Myanmar responsible for genocide in northern Rakhine State. The decision was reached by a 9-6 majority and marks the first time in the court's 80-year history that it has found a state responsible for committing genocide.
The court said genocidal intent was the only reasonable conclusion that could be drawn from the evidence before it.
## The case

The case was brought by The Gambia in 2019, accusing Myanmar of violating the 1948 Genocide Convention. The 2017 crackdown killed thousands of Rohingya and forced more than 700,000 to flee the country.
## Myanmar's position
Myanmar had denied the accusations, saying its forces were responding to attacks by armed groups.
